lore.custom_dropped: Words typed into fields of the lore list were taken out: this server takes picks from the list only.
lore.nothing_to_set: Nothing to set. To empty {field}, clear it.
lore.picked_only: {field} is picked from the lore list.
lore.trait_staff_only: {field} is set for good. Only the staff can change a trait.
lore.no_more_rerolls: {field} is set for good: no more rerolls.
lore.typed_for_good: {field} was typed in and is set for good.
lore.rolled: {field}: rolled {number} ({word}). Keep it, or reroll once.
lore.rolled_keep_or_reroll: {field} was rolled. Reroll it once, or keep it.
lore.not_picked: {field} is not picked from the lore list.
lore.nothing_fits: Nothing in the lore list fits {field} on this card.
lore.does_not_fit: {entry} does not fit {field} on this card.
lore.picked_and_cleared: {done} Cleared, as it went with the old choice: {fields}.
lore.too_long: {field} takes at most {max} characters, this is {length}.
lore.card_full: Your card would have {total} characters, the limit is {max}.
lore.not_in_list: That entry is not in the lore list.
lore.unreadable: Your card could not be read, so it cannot change now. The staff can find why in the server log.
lore.loading: Your card is still loading. Try again in a moment.
lore.too_fast: Slow down a little and try again.
lore.which_visibility: Who should see it: public or private?
lore.player_gone: That player is not here any more.
lore.name_public: Your name is now public: everyone sees it.
lore.name_private: Your name is now private: only those you introduced yourself to see it.
lore.intro_known: You and {name} know each other already.
lore.intro_waiting: You already asked {name}. Wait for an answer.
lore.intro_cooldown: You can introduce yourself again in {seconds} s.
lore.intro_asked: {name} wants to introduce themselves. Press Y to accept or N to decline within {seconds} s.
lore.intro_offered: You offered to introduce yourself to {name}.
lore.intro_know_now: You and {name} know each other now.
lore.intro_not_waiting: {name} is not waiting for your answer.
lore.intro_nobody_waiting: Nobody is waiting for your answer.
lore.cmd.mylore: /mylore - open or close your lore card (End)
lore.cmd.lore: /lore [number] - the lore card of the player in front of you, or of a player by number (Shift+End)
lore.cmd.introduce: /introduce [number] - introduce yourself to the player in front of you, or to a player by number
lore.cmd.forget: /forget <number> - that player no longer knows your name
lore.cmd.name: /name public|private - who sees your name: everyone, or only those you introduced yourself to
lore.cmd.alore: /alore <number> clear <field> - clear a field of a player's lore card
lore.staff_cleared: {field} cleared on the lore card of {name}.
lore.cleared_by_staff: The staff cleared {field} on your lore card.
lore.field.title: Title
lore.hint.title: A short title shown with the name, like "Caravan guard" or "of Leyawiin".
lore.hint.fullTitle: The long form, for those who like ceremony.
lore.hint.seenAs: What strangers see before they know your name, like "a scarred Khajiit with a merchant's sash". Always public.
lore.hint.race: Picked from the lore list. Your character in the game is the best guide.
lore.hint.subtype: Your kind within the race: a Khajiit furstock, a Bosmer clan, a Nord's descent. Pick the race first.
lore.hint.homeland: The province your character comes from: your race's own lands first, then the other provinces of Tamriel.
lore.hint.homeRegion: A region or town inside your homeland. Pick the homeland first.
lore.hint.culture: A house, tribe or culture of your race.
lore.hint.upbringing: How your character was raised. Your race's own ways come first.
lore.hint.standing: Where your character stood in society before setting out.
lore.hint.occupation: What your character did for a living before adventuring.
lore.hint.family: Parents, siblings, a spouse or children, in your own words.
lore.hint.ancestry: Family history in your own words: a grandmother from Skyrim, a line of smiths.
lore.hint.birthsign: The constellation your character was born under.
lore.hint.birthday: In your own words, like "16th of Rain's Hand".
lore.hint.age: A number or a description, like "late thirties".
lore.hint.class: What your character does best. Picked from Oblivion's classes.
lore.hint.faith: A god, a pantheon or a Daedric Prince.
lore.hint.affiliation: A guild, house or order your character belongs to in 3E 433.
lore.hint.rank: A rank in that affiliation, or a title of its own. Pick the affiliation first.
lore.hint.relationship: Unwed, courting, wed and the rest.
lore.hint.height: Free text, like "tall for a Bosmer".
lore.hint.hair: Free text: hair, fur or scales.
lore.hint.marks: Scars, tattoos, war paint, anything others would notice.
lore.hint.glance: What someone notices in the first few seconds.
lore.hint.physical: A longer description of how your character looks.
lore.hint.personality: How your character thinks, talks and behaves.
lore.hint.notes: Only for you: reminders, plans, debts. Other players never see this.
lore.hint.icOoc: In character, out of character, or looking for roleplay. Always public.
lore.hint.currently: What your character is doing right now, for anyone passing by.
lore.hint.oocInfo: Out of character notes: time zone, languages, what you enjoy in RP.
lore.hint.consent.injury: May others injure your character in a scene? Always public.
lore.hint.consent.death: May your character die in a scene? Always public.
lore.hint.consent.romance: Are you open to romance in RP? Always public.
lore.hint.consent.crime: May others steal from or cheat your character? Always public.
lore.hint.consent.control: Mind control, charm and the like. Always public.
lore.hint.experience: How much roleplay you have done, so others know what to expect.
lore.hint.trait.fearful: Shies from danger, flinches at threats, looks for the way out.
lore.hint.trait.hotTempered: Quick to anger and slow to cool. Insults are answered at once.
lore.hint.trait.melancholic: Prone to gloom, brooding and long silences.
lore.hint.trait.reckless: Acts first and thinks later. Danger is a dare.
lore.hint.trait.stubborn: Once a mind is made up, it stays made up.
lore.hint.trait.patient: Waits, listens and lets things ripen.
lore.hint.trait.romantic: Falls for people, poems and grand gestures. A romantic soul.
lore.hint.trait.jealous: Guards what is theirs, people included, and resents rivals.
lore.hint.trait.loyal: Stands by friends, lords and oaths, even when it costs.
lore.hint.trait.merciful: Spares the beaten and forgives the sorry.
lore.hint.trait.vengeful: Never forgets a wrong, and pays it back with interest.
lore.hint.trait.lustful: Led by desire more than by sense.
lore.hint.trait.lazy: Avoids effort, sleeps late, lets others carry the load.
lore.hint.trait.slovenly: Unwashed, untidy, careless with gear and looks.
lore.hint.trait.gluttonous: Eats too much, too often, and talks about food.
lore.hint.trait.greedy: Wants more coin and more things, and rarely shares.
lore.hint.trait.fondOfDrink: Mead, wine or skooma: never far from a cup.
lore.hint.trait.superstitious: Reads omens, carries charms, fears curses and the wrong moon.
lore.hint.trait.proud: Thinks highly of self and takes slights badly.
lore.hint.trait.deceitful: Lies easily, for gain or for fun.
lore.hint.trait.suspicious: Trusts nobody and sees plots everywhere.
lore.hint.trait.curious: Must know, must open, must see. Questions everything.
lore.hint.trait.pious: Prays, keeps the rites and lives by the faith.
lore.hint.trait.honourable: Keeps their word and fights fair, even with enemies.
